Cinnamon Roll Dough Baker's Percentage

Cinnamon Roll Dough is mixed from 500 g of flour at 58% water, no starter, 1.6% salt, and 1.4% yeast. This page scales the flour, water, salt, and yeast. Roll the dough out, add a cinnamon-sugar filling, and cut slices. Butter and egg are extra and are not in the totals.

Effective hydration 58%

Percentages are of the flour you weigh out, and effective hydration also counts the flour and water inside a starter that is itself 100% hydration.
